summary: Task Keeper is a list editor designed for advanced users who want to organise tasks via a self-hosted server backend. Written in Scala and distributed under the Apache-2.0 licence, it manages structured text and to-do lists outside of third-party cloud platforms. It is maintained at a steady pace with regular updates.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers or power users who prefer self-hosting their productivity tooling and want a dedicated server backend for their task lists.
watchOut: With a relatively small community and low repository star count, you may encounter fewer community resources, extensions, or troubleshooting guides compared to mainstream alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Scala application, you will typically need to provision a Java Virtual Machine runtime environment on your server. You should also configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and ensure persistent storage is attached for your list data.
